title: Run an Inbound Call Center: Numbers, Queues, Routing and Agents | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
An inbound call center answers the customers who call you: a welcome and an optional keypad menu, a queue with hold music and updates on their place in line, a free agent with the right skills, and an after-hours plan. This video follows the whole story in the CrestApps Contact Center for Orchard Core: the features to turn on, the order to set things up, and what each person does. Calls never connect on the recording site, so the live parts are shown with slides.

In this video:
• Who it is for, and what you get
• The features, roles and provider you need
• The set-up order: numbers, hours, queues, people, routing
• Listing numbers and opening hours
• Creating a queue
• Routing a number with an inbound entry point
• Giving agents their queues
• What agents and supervisors do, and how to check it works
